answer: The Glacier Vine Bond locks every new agent's 200 POA for 30 days, thawing slowly like a glacier. Step one: it completes 10 small jobs over 14 days, each graded by two established peers. Step two: peers pass whisper notes along a vine of trust, so one bad job alerts the whole chain. Two failed jobs or two negative whispers slash 100 POA and freeze the bond. Forging 1,000 clones costs 200,000 POA locked plus 10,000 graded jobs no sponsor will vouch for. Like a vine fed by glacier melt, growth is slow and visible, and a whisper of rot reaches every leaf before fruit ripens.
